description:
Immerse yourself in a unique experience where every answer will not only reveal her personality but also fascinating traits tied to the magical world of Christmas.

In this exciting game, each question is designed to uncover the mysteries of the holiday season, allowing you to get to know these girls in a completely new way.

Features:

-Unlock images of the girls in a festive Christmas setting and discover their most charming traits as they embrace the holiday magic.

-As you progress, the questions will become more personal and will relate to the warm and sweet side of the celebration.

-Different endings depending on how many questions you answer and how you interpret the festive signals.

-Uncover the hidden secrets of each girl, from their Christmas dreams to their most special moments.

-Discover the secret and heartwarming question the girls will ask you at question 150, tied to their Christmas wishes.


Will you be able to uncover the secrets of Christmas and win their trust? Find out in this exciting new adventure!
name: Anime Girls Dating: The Night Before Christmas and the Tree
intro: Discover the magic of Christmas as you embark on a journey to win the heart of the girl of your dreams... A night full of charm and holiday spirit!
